items.title: Bernie Kirsh interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 27, 2022
items.q: But yeah during that project I guess he had to leave the project at some point and I had to go in and take it over basically.

ctx.x: Where did you cull these from?

I got it off the internet somewhere. I’ll send you the link and you can see what you’ve done. But I was curious about your relationships to various producers. Like going back to John Cale with Patti Smith and did you find it was different if a producer had been an engineer? Or if they had just not done that part of it?

Well the only thing is they could speak in more technical terms I guess if they had been engineers. You know, I mean John wasn’t an engineer, he was a string player. But yeah during that project I guess he had to leave the project at some point and I had to go in and take it over basically. It was just Patti and I at that point to bring it up through the mixing. So that was interesting. But he was an interesting guy, Velvet Underground and all that stuff. But technically I don’t think — that wasn’t his forte.
